description: This dataset contains ROV survey data collected on September 8, 2020, during event PS122/5_61-35. It includes twenty unique binary file references, such as depth profiles and telemetry timeseries, linked to specific oceanographic measurements. The records are geographically anchored at latitude 88.675993 and longitude 112.324519, with an elevation of -4291.4 meters. Researchers can use this information to analyze underwater environmental conditions, including sea ice draft and optical properties. The data supports detailed spatial and temporal aggregation, making it valuable for studying deep-sea ecosystems and validating remote sensing instruments in polar regions.
